sources.title: Introducing Fabrix Triton: Specialized AI models for Enterprise IT ...
sources.snippet: For the last few years, enterprise AI strategy has followed one script: pick the biggest frontier model available, point it at every problem, and pay per token. That script is starting to break down, and Fabrix built Triton because we saw the cracks first. What Is Triton? Triton is Fabrix's family of specialized small language models (SLMs), AI purpose-built for enterprise IT operations ...
